_note: Colab L4, sized for ~8h on the current fp32 code (no resume). The L4 is memory-bandwidth bound (~300 GB/s): the 60M / ctx-512 run measured 1.51 s/step = 30h for 72k steps. Context 256 cuts the naive-attention B x H x L x L traffic 4x per sequence; ~33M params (25M non-embedding) suits the ~330M tokens 8h buys (~1.5 passes, ~10 tokens/param). Batch 32 x 256 = same 8k tokens/step. After the speed test set max_steps = 27000 / s_per_step (s/step timed between log lines, not including evals).
_next: Once SDPA + bf16 autocast exist: context 512, d_model 768, num_layers 12, num_heads 12, d_ff 2048 (~95M), max_lr 6e-4, ~1B tokens.
